summary: Nimbus Range (UNC-THREAD) is exploiting CVE-2026-44011, a pre-auth deserialization bug in an IIS native WAF module. Code execution lands in w3wp.exe, which then spawns cmd.exe and encoded PowerShell, drops cobb.dll under the IIS temporary compressed files directory, and persists via a Run key.

sigma.title: IIS Worker Spawning Encoded PowerShell
sigma.description: Detects IIS worker process w3wp.exe spawning cmd.exe or powershell.exe, a behavior observed during exploitation of CVE-2026-44011 (Project Cobalt Thread) where a native module runs shellcode in the worker and launches an encoded PowerShell download cradle.
falsepositives: Administrator-launched IIS troubleshooting from an interactive session (not from w3wp.exe)
Custom IIS modules that legitimately shell out — validate against the application inventory

caveats: Primary detection is the w3wp.exe process tree. Hash 9f86d081... is taken from the advisory and should not be the sole detector. Linux nginx path is explicitly out of scope.
